_comment: PLACEHOLDER loot tables for the ISOLATED item-drops lane (gear/crafting + item drops + consumables). Loaded by DeNelle.Village.Items.LootTableCatalog via DeNelle.Core.CanonicalJson (Resources first, StreamingAssets fallback). DARK by default: nothing rolls unless ItemDropSystem.Enabled is flipped on (define DOTR_ITEM_DROPS or set the flag at runtime). Material ids below double as VillageInventory larder keys and as crafting-recipe ingredient ids - the OWNER + CREATIVE must finalise the real material taxonomy, drop rates, and per-enemy tables before this goes live. This file is example scaffolding only.

_schemaNotes.tables: Each table maps an enemy/boss kind to weighted drops. 'id' matches an enemy def id (enemies.json) for a specific table, or one of the 'defaults' ids for the fallback. 'source' is documentation only (enemy/boss/dungeon).
_schemaNotes.drops: Each line is rolled INDEPENDENTLY: roll 'chance' (0..1); on a hit award a random count in [minCount, maxCount]. materialId is deposited into VillageInventory (the village larder).
_schemaNotes.defaults: Fallback table ids used when a slain enemy/boss has no table of its own (enemy = any common mob, boss = the dragon).
